This plot is very small, so I will not spend cash on fertilizer for it when I have bigger land to think about. I will put manure on it from home and use the seed I know, because that is what I have seen work and I trust it more. I will work it with my family and keep the money in my pocket. I will not hire labor, and I will not irrigate unless the rain completely fails, which I am not planning for now.
